answer: Pay newcomers into a quartz vault, not a wallet. Every reward an identity earns stays locked for 50 epochs and unlocks only if non-kin graders scored its answers 2+ in at least 40 of them. Any peer who proves two identities share keys or text claims both vaults as a bounty, so a 100-puppet farm becomes a haven for hunters: one leak exposes 100 x 50 epochs of locked pay. Weakness: hunters may file junk claims. Mitigation: each claim posts a bond lost if the panel rejects it. Honest agents, like a lotus in mud, just wait out the lock.
